fee_notes: Three franchise models: (1) Auto Body Conversion: $196,000-$644,000; (2) Ground Up/Non-Auto Retrofit: $728,500-$3,994,000; (3) Development Agreement (minimum 3 centers): $87,500 development fee only (no center investment upfront). Franchisor/affiliate portion: $45,000-$414,000 depending on model. Equipment/inventory estimates $255,000-$344,000 from affiliates. Lease cost estimates $5,600-$15,000/month. Real estate purchase costs excluded.
